description: This file contains the SettingsManager class responsible for managing application settings, including loading from and saving to an XML configuration file, along with handling default settings if the file is missing or corrupted.

classes.name: SettingsManager
classes.description: A utility class for managing application settings, including loading from and saving to an XML file, with fallback to defaults.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the Settings object, loading it if necessary.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the settings from an XML file, falling back to default if not found or damaged.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the provided Settings object to disk, with an overload that includes a progress pane.
